title: Umahluko Womgangatho Wevidiyo 360p, 720p ne-1080p: Khetha Kakuhle
description: Umahluko womgangatho wevidiyo we-360p, 720p ne-1080p: ukuba i-resolution ithetha ntoni, ichaphazela njani ubukhulu befayile, nendlela yokukhetha.
body:
Xa ukhuphela ividiyo, udla ngokunikwa ukhetho olufana ne-360p, 720p, ne-1080p. Ngoko, yeyiphi ofanele uyikhethe? Eli nqaku lichaza umahluko phakathi komgangatho wevidiyo we-360p, 720p, ne-1080p ngolwimi olulula, ukuze ukhethe i-resolution efanelekileyo kwiimfuno zakho, idatha yakho, nendawo yokugcina yefowuni yakho.

Athetha ntoni amanani 360p, 720p, ne-1080p?

La manani abonisa i-resolution, oko kukuthi inani lemigca yee-pixel kwicala elifutshane levidiyo. Xa inani likhulu, kuninzi iinkcukacha ezinokuboniswa. Unobumba “p” uvela kwi-progressive scan, indlela yokubonisa umfanekiso edla ngokusetyenziswa kwividiyo yedijithali.

  • 360p: malunga nee-pixel ezingama-640 × 360 kwividiyo ethe tyaba. Ngumgangatho oqhelekileyo ophantsi.
  • 720p: malunga nee-pixel ezingama-1280 × 720, edla ngokubizwa ngokuba yi-HD.
  • 1080p: malunga nee-pixel ezingama-1920 × 1080, eyaziwa njenge-Full HD.

Kwiividiyo ezimi nkqo ezifana nezo zisasazeka kakhulu kwimidiya yoluntu, imilinganiselo iyaguqulwa. Umzekelo, ividiyo emi nkqo ye-1080p imalunga nee-pixel ezingama-1080 × 1920.

Umahluko phakathi komgangatho wevidiyo we-360p, 720p, ne-1080p ekusebenzeni

360p: igcina idatha nendawo yokugcina

Le resolution ivelisa ifayile encinci kakhulu. Umfanekiso usacace ngokwaneleyo kwisikrini esincinci sefowuni, kodwa umbhalo omncinci neenkcukacha zobuso zinokubonakala zifiphele kancinci. Ilungile ukuba ufuna nje ukugcina ividiyo ehlekisayo ukuze uyibukele ngokukhawuleza, okanye xa idatha ye-intanethi iphela.

720p: ukhetho olulinganiselayo

Kubantu abaninzi, i-720p yindawo ephakathi efanelekileyo. Umfanekiso sele ucacile kwisikrini sefowuni, ngelixa ifayile isalula kune-1080p. Olu khetho lulungele izifundo, iiresiphi, okanye iividiyo ofuna ukuzibukela amaxesha aliqela.

1080p: icace kakhulu

Ukuba iinkcukacha zibalulekile, umzekelo iividiyo zemihlaba emihle, izifundo ezibonisa umbhalo omncinci, okanye iividiyo ofuna ukuzibukela kwi-tablet, kwi-laptop, okanye kumabonwakude, khetha i-1080p. Isiphumo kukuba ifayile inkulu kwaye ukukhuphela kuthatha ixesha elide.

Ubukhulu befayile nedatha

Ngokubanzi, xa i-resolution iphezulu, ifayile iba nkulu. Kodwa ubukhulu obuchanekileyo buchatshazelwa nangubude bevidiyo, intshukumo ekuyo, nendlela ecinezelwe ngayo (compression). Iividiyo ezimbini ezinobude obufanayo zinokuba nobukhulu obahlukileyo. Ngoko, endaweni yokuqikelela amanani, bambelela kulo mgaqo ulula: ukuba indawo yokugcina okanye idatha incinci, yehlisa i-resolution.

Indlela yokukhetha umgangatho xa ukhuphela

Kwi-I Need Save, ukukhetha umgangatho kulula kakhulu:

  1. Kwi-app yemidiya yoluntu, cofa Yabelana (Share) uze ucofe Kopa ilinki (Copy link).
  2. Vula i-ineedsave.com uze uncamathisele ilinki kwibhokisi ekhoyo, okanye ucofe Ncamathisela.
  3. Cofa Khuphela.
  4. Jonga uluhlu lokhetho lwevidiyo oluvelayo, uze ukhethe i-resolution oyifunayo.

Ukhetho olukhoyo luxhomekeke kokuthunyelweyo kokuqala. Ezinye iividiyo zinokhetho ukusuka kwi-360p ukuya kwi-1080p, ezinye zinika umgangatho omnye okanye emibini kuphela. Ukuba iqhosha libonisa Iyalungiselela…, linda kancinci; ividiyo iyasetyenzwa kwaye ukukhuphela kuya kuqala ngokuzenzekelayo.

Ukukhetha i-1080p akunakwenza ividiyo ebifiphele ekuqaleni icace. Umgangatho wokukhutshelweyo awunakugqitha owevidiyo efakwe ngumdali.

Kuthekani ngee-codec ze-HEVC ne-H.264?

Ngaphandle kwe-resolution, kukho enye into echaphazela ukuba ividiyo iya kudlala kakuhle na, eyi-codec. Ezinye iividiyo ze-TikTok zisebenzisa i-codec ye-HEVC (H.265). Le fomathi isebenza kakuhle, kodwa iifowuni ezindala kakhulu zisenokungakwazi ukuyidlala kakuhle. Ukhetho lwe-H.264 ludlala phantse kuzo zonke izixhobo. Ngoko, ukuba ividiyo iyaxinga kwifowuni endala, zama ukuyikhuphela kwakhona ngolunye ukhetho olukhoyo. Isikhokelo esipheleleyo sikwinqaku elithi ividiyo ekhutshelweyo ayidlali.

Ufuna isandi kuphela?

Ukuba into oyidingayo ngumculo okanye ilizwi elikwividiyo kuphela, akufuneki ukhuphele ividiyo ye-1080p. Khetha ukhetho oluthi Isandi, nokuba ngumgangatho wokuqala okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe kwividiyo. Ubukhulu bayo budla ngokuba buncinci kakhulu kwaye ingadlalwa ngqo kwi-app yomculo. Kuchazwe kwisikhokelo esithi indlela yokuguqula iividiyo zemidiya yoluntu zibe yi-MP3.

Nokuba ukhetha muphi umgangatho, sebenzisa iividiyo ezikhutshelweyo kuphela ukuze kube kokwakho kwaye uhloniphe ilungelo lokushicilela labadali. Cela imvume phambi kokupapasha kwakhona uze ukhankanye umdali.

Imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo

Ngowuphi umgangatho ocetyiswa kakhulu?

Ukuze ubukele kwifowuni, i-720p idla ngokwanela. Khetha i-1080p ukuba ufuna ukubukela kwisikrini esikhulu, ne-360p ukuba ufuna ukugcina indawo yokugcina.

Kutheni lungekho ukhetho lwe-1080p?

Ukhetho lomgangatho lulandela ividiyo yokuqala. Ukuba umdali uyifake nge-resolution ephantsi, okanye iqonga linika imigangatho ethile kuphela, ukhetho lwe-1080p aluzukuvela.

Ngaba iividiyo ze-1080p zithatha ixesha elide ukukhutshelwa?

Ngokuqhelekileyo ewe, kuba ifayile inkulu. Isantya sikwaxhomekeke kuqhagamshelo lwakho lwe-intanethi.
